text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
O Crystal Ball! Reveal unto me the future! 
Abracadabra, extra happy toppings! Max 
good luck, extra sweet life, Mt. 
Chomolungma style!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm............? No good...... 
Everything through the crystal ball just 
looks all squiggly and wobbly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah, crystal ball fortune-telling is 
so hard. Maybe I just don't have the 
talent for it~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It really is difficult, isn't it... How do 
you usually do it, Fukukitaru-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You have to keep looking with total 
belief! And then interpret whatever you 
see in your own way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Interpret, interpret, huh... It sounds 
tough, but I'll give it one more shot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Oh, floating in the dark... Is 
that Earth? Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The Earth is going to be destroyed!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeeeeeek~!? There's such a thing as 
being totally beyond saving~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look! The Earth started spinning 
and rolling away, and then it vanished 
completely!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeek~!! Isn't that an unmistakable 
vision of the end of the world?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
C-Could today really be the last day of 
Earth~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No way, I don't want that~!! There are 
still so many things I want to do! Like, 
for example—
(Grumble~~~~~)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Eat lunch!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to have an empty stomach when the 
world ends, no wayyyy~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Higyaaaaaaa!! Let's hurry before all of 
creation sells out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to check on the 
fortune-telling booth, the three of them 
came bursting out. Right behind them, 
something rolled out of the hut.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, the harmony of sweet carrot and juicy 
burger meat... To think I'll never get to 
eat this again~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Buuut! I'm so glad I got to eat carrot 
hamburg steaks with everyone one last 
time, waaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It's a small comfort at least~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about tomorrow's 
weigh-in! Let's order as much as we want!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~, since this is our very last bowl! 
Make it 'honey soft, extra rich, extra 
toppings, maxed out' please~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*slurp slurp* ..................The Earth 
isn't being destroyed, is it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, when exactly is it supposed 
to end...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's divine it once more!! It's not 
entirely out of the question that its 
destruction is actually 10 billion years 
from now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, we're in a hurry right now! The 
Earth is in mortal danger!! Could you 
please step inside and wait?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three seemed preoccupied with their 
fortune-telling. Not wanting to disturb 
them, I set the globe down on an empty 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
!!! I see it! The Earth! Even though it 
was rolling away and vanishing earlier! 
The Earth is shining brilliantly!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The Earth has been saved~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I glanced at the globe I had just put 
back. If I recall... it was rolling across 
the floor earlier. Could she have just 
seen the falling globe through the crystal 
ball...?
choice_data_list:
(Well, no need to go out of my way to 
point that out.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah~!! I'm so glad the Earth was 
saved~!! Let's keep doing our best with 
the fortune-telling booth starting 
tomorrow too~!!
